_doc.what: Per-asset parameters for refine_trellis_glb.py (Stage 2 of the TRELLIS.2 art pipeline, TASK-083). Law: CONVENTIONS.md 'Textured mesh law (TRELLIS.2 art pipeline)'.
_doc.merging: 'defaults' apply to every asset; per-asset keys override (dict values merge one level deep).
_doc.units: All *_ue values are Unreal units (= cm). The script works in Blender meters internally (1 m = 100 UE) and exports with apply_unit_scale=True, matching the blockout FBX convention.
_doc.mode: 'bake' = full remesh/decimate + Cycles CPU bake to D/N/ORM (standard). 'native' = keep TRELLIS's own mesh/UVs/textures, WebP->PNG convert only (escape hatch for bake artifacts). CLI --mode overrides.
_doc.fit_mode: 'height' = uniform scale so Z matches target (units — silhouette-preserving; X/Y deviation is warn-only in the report). 'box' = exact per-axis scale to the target box (buildings — guarantees the ±10% blockout-bounds ruling).
_doc.origin: Documentation of the origin rule; 'feet-center' (units) and 'ground-center' (buildings) are both implemented as XY-bbox-center at (0,0) with min Z = 0, per the TASK-014/037/038 blockout definitions.
_doc.pre_rotate_z_deg: Rotation applied before scaling so the model's FRONT faces Blender -Y (blockout facing contract). TRELLIS output orientation is unknown until the first live generation — tune per asset at the TASK-086/087 eyeball gate.
_doc.team_region: Selectors choose the minority face-set for material slot 0 'TeamRegion' (remainder = slot 1 '<CardID>PBR'). Each selector may carry 'box' (normalized conformed-bounds coords: x 0=-X..1=+X, y 0=front(-Y)..1=back(+Y), z 0=ground..1=top; face selected when its center lies inside) and/or 'normal' ({direction, min_dot}: face normal dot >= min_dot). Conditions within a selector AND together; selectors OR together. Selection over max_fraction of surface area (or zero faces) is a report WARNING, not a failure — the pre-import eyeball gate rules. All selector values below are STARTING GUESSES against not-yet-generated meshes.
_doc.ucx: Buildings only: authored UCX_SM_<CardID>_00.. box hulls exported inside the FBX. 'boxes' entries are {center:[x,y,z], size:[x,y,z]} in UE units in conformed space. Castle law: wall-footprint-exact, NEVER a full base slab (M1 ~410-unit placement dead-zone lesson). Units carry ucx:null — their <=4 simple hulls are generated at Stage-3 import (TASK-037 recipe), not authored here.
_doc.bake: cage_extrusion_ue / max_ray_distance_ue feed Cycles selected-to-active baking; ao_samples applies to the AO pass only (spec: 64 spp), 'samples' to all other passes.

Old shield_band guess striped the spear arm/shaft; replaced with helmet dome (x-constrained to exclude the spearhead) + upward-facing shoulder caps.

Archer._dims_source: TASK-037 blockout: 125.0 x 67.3 x 180.0, feet-center, bow -X, quiver on back (+Y), front -Y

team_region._tuned: TASK-087 eyeball gate 2026-07-08: original cap selector painted the archer's bare HEAD (blue face) and the quiver box splattered the surcoat back - 27.1% selected. Probe-measured (probe_fbx): quiver+fletching at y>0.85 / x 0-0.45, hair back also above z 0.85, so the quiver box caps at z 0.85 (fletching stays natural). Replaced with Footman-recipe upward-facing pauldron caps + a tight quiver-body box.

Ogre._dims_source: TASK-147 blockout: 226.72 x 98.8 x 290.0, feet-center, front -Y. Roster's TALLEST unit (Z 290). X width includes the overhead club (weapon overhang) so it is warn-only under fit_mode height (Z 290 is matched exactly). Measured headless from Content/RawAssets/Ogre.fbx (object SM_Ogre, 1572 tris).

team_region._guess: TASK-147 STARTING GUESS against a not-yet-generated mesh (tuned at the TASK-150 eyeball gate). Concept: bare GREEN-skinned horned brute in tattered hide + spiked shoulder pauldron armor, chest straps, wide belt, stone maul in one fist. Follows the Footman/Archer shoulder-cap recipe but DELIBERATELY OMITS a helm_dome selector: the ogre has NO helmet (bare horned head) so any full-width top-z dome would paint his face/head/horns (the Archer bare-head lesson, TASK-087). Single upward-facing shoulder-cap band kept BELOW the head to target the pauldron/shoulder armor only. Expect a gate tune once the live mesh's shoulder/head z-bands are probe-measured.

Castle._dims_source: TASK-013 blockout: 814.5 x 820.0 x 900.0, ground-center; box fit keeps bounds well inside the ±10% ruling

team_region._tuned: TASK-087 eyeball gate 2026-07-08: box-fit Z-stretch (17.6 vs 8.2 Y-scale) steepened every roof, so min_dot 0.3 selected only 1.1% (a few inner keep roofs). Probe-measured upward-face area lives in dot 0.10-0.30; z floor lowered to 0.30 to include perimeter tower cones + wall-walk tops (strong top-down read). Measured 6.8% at dot 0.10 / z 0.30 - Footman-comparable.
